name: Indus
introduction: is the Indian, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s, probably representing the people they met on their voyages. It is a faint constellation in the southern sky.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Indus contains one of the closest Sun-like stars. [Epsilon Indi](id:10pc-0040), about 12 light-years away, is orbited by a pair of brown dwarfs and a giant planet. In 2024, the James Webb Space Telescope captured a direct image of the planet, one of the coldest planets ever imaged outside the Solar System.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Indi](hip:101772) is an orange giant about 100 light-years away. [Beta Indi](hip:103227) is an orange bright giant much farther away.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Indus lies away from the Milky Way, toward galaxies such as NGC 7090, a spiral seen edge-on.
